**Finding: deviation (WARRANTY) — redline validated and submitted.**

What I found:

- **Section 9 ("TRUELINK WARRANTIES", p0059–p0060)** is the counterparty's only warranty to us, and it covers *only* Year 2000 date processing. There is no professional/workmanlike services warranty, no conformance-to-documentation warranty for the Interface or related software, no compliance-with-laws or malicious-code warranty, and no remedy (repair/replace/re-perform/refund).
- **Asymmetry:** Section 8 loads compliance, content-ownership, legal-compliance and malicious-code warranties onto Client (p0051, p0055–p0056), with nothing reciprocal from TrueLink.
- **Disclaimer check:** p0076 disclaims fitness and merchantability but opens with "EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY SET FORTH IN THIS AGREEMENT," so it does **not** swallow express warranties — no carve-out edit needed. p0041/p0042 separately disclaim data accuracy, which I left alone as a reasonable vendor position on third-party credit repository data.

Redline (inserted after p0060, preferred position): TrueLink warrants (a) professional and workmanlike performance of the Hosting and Support Services, (b) 12-month conformance of the Interface and software to its documentation plus freedom from malicious code, and (c) compliance with applicable laws — with re-performance, repair/replacement, or refund of fees for the non-conforming item as our remedy. The comment offers the 90-day fallback.
